summary_en: ROE 0.78% (FY3/26), WACC 3.00%, ROIC 0.46%, PBR 0.40x. Target ROE 2.20% by FY3/29 via revenue growth, gross-margin improvement, SG&A control, and ongoing evaluation of buyback and dividend increases. Execution aligned with 3-year plan (FY3/27–3/29).
title_en: Regarding Response to Realizing Management Conscious of Cost of Capital and Stock Price
translation_en_brief:
Heiwa Shigyo has published a capital-cost assessment and multi-year response plan. Current position: ROE of 0.78% (FY3/26) falls far below the calculated cost of equity (4.43%); ROIC of 0.46% lags WACC of 3.00%; PBR stands at 0.40x, indicating weak market valuation despite modest gains in stock price and book value. The company attributes the low PBR to insufficient market communication of business and growth strategy.

Response pathway through FY3/29: ROE target is 2.20% (a stated waypoint, not the end-goal), to be achieved through (1) revenue expansion via existing customer deepening and new customer acquisition, (2) gross-margin gains from higher-margin product sales, (3) SG&A discipline to lift operating profit, (4) capital redeployment toward high-growth niches (specialty paper and non-paper specialty materials), and (5) intensified investor relations. The plan is integrated with the company's published 3-year business plan (FY3/27–3/29). Management notes ongoing evaluation of share buyback and dividend increases, conditional on maintaining sound finances and adequate equity ratios.
